title: Estimating Functional Independence Measure Scores From Japanese Rehabilitation Notes Using a Large Language Model: Retrospective Study.
summary: An LLM estimated item-level Functional Independence Measure scores from Japanese rehabilitation notes and was compared with clinical reference assessments across disease cohorts. Published in JMIR Medical Informatics.
ai_technology: Methods describe the note sources and score estimation; Results report errors by therapist-note type, disease and admission-score strata.
